name: stm_rook_open_or_semi_open_file
description: Side to move has at least one rook on a file with no opponent pawns (open or semi-open file).
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_rook_open_or_semi_open_file'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has at least one rook on a file with no opponent pawns (open or semi-open file).'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    for rook_sq in board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm):
        rook_file = chess.square_file(rook_sq)
        opp_has_pawn = False
        for pawn_sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp):
            if chess.square_file(pawn_sq) == rook_file:
                opp_has_pawn = True
                break
        if not opp_has_pawn:
            return True
    return False
